nodes.description: Address of the contract creator, used as the access-control gate for privileged functions.
Address that receives the 5% developer fee on every hero purchase.
Dynamic array of Hero structs holding hero name, owner, DBZ owner, price and level.
Number of heroes in the Tournament of Power (55), used as modulus for random winner generation.
Array storing randomly generated winning hero IDs.
Boolean pause flag controlling whether heroes can be purchased.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, creator checks and new hero ownership assignment.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as entropy source for the pseudo-random winner generation.
heroes[_heroId].ownerAddress.transfer(commissionOwner): external ETH transfer of 75% to the previous hero owner.
heroes[_heroId].DBZHeroOwnerAddress.transfer(DBZHeroOwnerCommission): external ETH transfer of 10%.
devFeeAddress.transfer(devFee): external ETH transfer of 5% to the developer.
winner.transfer(TotalPrize20PercentShare): external ETH payout of 20% to each winner inside a loop.
price doubling via mul() on currentPrice, a multiplication that may overflow.
heroes[_heroId].currentLevel += 1: unchecked integer increment that may overflow.
sha256(block.timestamp, block.number-i-1) % heroMax: pseudo-random winner generation depending on miner-controlled values.
Sets isPaused to true; restricted by onlyContractCreator.
Sets isPaused to false; restricted by onlyContractCreator.
Returns the current value of isPaused.
Payable hero purchase that splits msg.value into fees, transfers ETH to three parties, increments level and doubles the price.
Creator-only function that overwrites hero metadata and owner addresses.
Allows the current hero owner to lower the current price of their hero.
Returns all details of a given hero from storage.
Returns the current price of a given hero.
Returns the current level of a given hero.
Returns the owner address of a given hero.
Returns the DBZ owner address of a given hero.
Returns the contract balance as the total prize.
Internal SafeMath-style multiplication with an overflow assertion.
Internal SafeMath-style integer division.
Creator-only function pushing a new Hero into the heroes array.
Creator-only function that generates 5 pseudo-random winning hero IDs using block.timestamp and block.number.
Returns the winning hero ID stored at a given index in winners.
Creator-only function that loops over 5 winners and transfers 20% of the contract balance to each.
Hero index used as an array offset for price check and state updates.
Hero index whose details are being updated.

New owner address assigned by the creator.
New DBZ hero owner address checked against the current owner.
New level assigned to the hero.

Hero index queried for full details.

Hero index queried for its DBZ owner.
First multiplication operand (current hero price).

Divisor of the internal division helper.

Initial level of the hero being added.
Index into the winners array.
10% of msg.value reserved for the tournament prize.
5% of msg.value paid to devFeeAddress.
10% of msg.value paid to the DBZ hero owner.
Remaining 75% of msg.value paid to the previous hero owner.
20% share of the contract balance computed once before the payout loop.
Loop counter for generating the five winner IDs.
Loop counter for the payout iteration.
Winning hero ID retrieved from getWinnerDetails during payout.
Owner address of the winning hero that receives the prize.
Product of a and b validated by the overflow assertion.
Quotient of the division helper.
Storage pointer to the queried Hero struct.

edges.reason: onlyContractCreator modifier compares msg.sender against contractCreator before pausing.
onlyContractCreator modifier gates the unpause function.
Hero detail updates are gated by the contractCreator check.
Hero creation is gated by the contractCreator check.
Random winner generation is gated by the contractCreator check.
Prize payout is gated by the contractCreator check.
msg.sender is compared to contractCreator inside the pause guard.
msg.sender is compared to contractCreator inside the unpause guard.
msg.sender must equal contractCreator to update hero details.
msg.sender must equal contractCreator to add a hero.
msg.sender must equal contractCreator to generate winners.
msg.sender must equal contractCreator to trigger the payout.
msg.sender becomes the new hero owner after a successful purchase, transferring privileges.
msg.sender must match heroes[_heroId].ownerAddress to modify the hero price.
block.timestamp feeds the sha256 pseudo-random winner generation, making it miner-influenceable.
State is updated after the previous owner receives ETH via transfer, an external call inside purchaseHero.
External ETH transfer to the DBZ hero owner occurs before owner/price state updates.
External ETH transfer to devFeeAddress occurs before owner and price state updates.
currentPrice is doubled through multiplication, an overflow-sensitive operation.
currentLevel is incremented with +=1, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
purchaseHero calls the internal mul helper to double the hero price.
mul performs the potentially overflowing price multiplication.
getWinner derives winner IDs from block.timestamp and block.number, an insecure randomness source.
Prize ETH transfers happen inside a loop before the winner local is reset.
payoutWinners calls getWinnerDetails to resolve each winning hero ID.
GetGamestatus reads and returns the isPaused state variable.
purchaseHero requires isPaused to be false, gating the purchase.
purchaseHero reads and writes hero price, level and owner fields in the heroes array.
modifyCurrentHeroPrice reads and writes the hero price inside the heroes array.
updateDBZHeroDetails writes hero metadata into the heroes array.
payoutWinners reads hero owner addresses from the heroes array.
getWinner pushes the generated hero IDs into the winners array.
payoutWinners consumes the winners array through getWinnerDetails.
devFeeAddress is the recipient of the external development fee transfer.
heroMax is used as the modulus when generating random winner IDs.
